entry.title: Ireland’s Missing Check on the Law
entry.summary: Good law requires more than popular approval. It needs an objective standard to measure it against and a legislature that asks whether it will work in practice. Ireland has abandoned both, leaving it to agencies and courts to decide, case by case, what its laws mean.
